recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: DV-headroom precondition class: gate an experiment on the DEPENDENT variable's achievable range against its own registered threshold, not only on whether the intervention was applied
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: Every readiness gate in this corpus certifies the INTERVENTION (was the channel perturbed, did the head train, were there enough samples) and none certifies that the DV had room to move. Across the seven 2026-09-03 pending-review runs, six passed all preconditions and still could not discriminate, because the registered pass threshold lay outside the range the configuration could produce: V3-EXQ-981 C1 threshold 1.154 on a DV bounded in [0,1]; V3-EXQ-981 precision-margin elevation ceiling 0.000195 vs floor 0.01 (51x); V3-EXQ-951c gate_caused with zero possible ticks; V3-EXQ-983 repeat_rate range 0.0468 vs 0.15 (3.2x); V3-EXQ-993 calibration_gap max 0.00152 vs 0.02 (13.1x); V3-EXQ-994 retention spread 0.00078 vs 0.02 (25.6x); V3-EXQ-978 arm-mean difference one third of the DV's 0.05 quantum. BUILD: extend ree-v3/validate_experiments.py with a `criterion_exceeds_achievable_range` check in the same WARN-only family as the existing `dry_run_unreachable_criterion` lint, plus a runtime `dv_headroom` precondition kind in experiments/_metrics.py p0_readiness_gate() that measures the control arm's realised DV range and routes to substrate_not_ready_requeue when the registered threshold exceeds it. Two specific sub-cases the lint must catch: a multiplicative threshold on a bounded DV (981's 2x on [0,1]), and a threshold above the arithmetic ceiling implied by a saturated baseline (981's 0.01 floor against 0.000195 available).

THAT RECOMMENDATION IS WITHDRAWN. EXT-003's own evidence_quality_note records a USER RULING made at the /governance Step 3 gate on 2026-09-03 -- the same day -- stating verbatim: 'What this claim actually waits on is EXPERIMENTAL evidence, the load-bearing channel. Status stays candidate for THAT reason, not for conflict resolution.' `out_of_domain` is a member of _UNTESTABLE_EPISTEMIC (generate_inter_governance_workset.py:988-991), so the stamp would make the claim structurally unable to receive the very evidence channel the user ruled it is waiting on. All four probes were moreover dispatched from experiment_proposals.v1.json as proposal_type `experimental` rows against the EXT ids themselves, so the project's standing convention already treats these claims as experimentally testable through their ree_mechanism riders. The category is therefore `standard` for all four. The observation that an EXT claim's assertion is about transformer systems while the run measures the rider is RETAINED as a note on experiment CONSTRUCTION -- it explains why these probes must be built to test the rider explicitly -- but it does not drive a category and it is not a reason to withhold experimental evidence.
